findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: extract_webpage, ping_status, read_feed · Private data: get_document, geocode, extract_tables, render_document, token_audit, crypto_prices, gas_tracker, wallet_portfolio, simulate_tx, query_specs · Public sink: domain_intel, simulate_tx · Destructive: site_speed.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: extract_webpage, ping_status, read_feed · Private data: get_document, geocode, extract_tables, render_document, token_audit, crypto_prices, gas_tracker, wallet_portfolio, simulate_tx, query_specs · Public sink: domain_intel, simulate_tx · Destructive: site_speed

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
